<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
Three issues are clear: redundant tree growth on navigation, missing branch highlighting during vote merging, and absent top toolbar in fullscreen mode.

The redundant growth comes from a useEffect in ForestDemo.tsx that fires whenever focusTree changes while the stage is "grow". Trees should stay fully grown after training and not replay their animation when clicked.

The fix is to stop the grow animation from firing when focusTree changes. Clicking a tree button should reveal the fully grown tree immediately without replaying its growth sequence.

The effect depends on `focusTree`, which resets `revealNodes` to 1 and restarts the animation. Removing that dependency will let switching trees jump straight to the fully grown state. The effect should only trigger when entering the "grow" stage or when the user explicitly clicks "Replay growth".

The merge votes effect only increments `revealVotes` without animating the path down the tree. The "Walk through trees" animation uses `pathIndex` and `flow` to highlight branches. Merge votes needs the same path animation so each vote reveals along its branch.

The missing branch highlighting is caused by TreeView disabling path animation during the "vote" stage. The fix is to enable pathIndex and flow props for the vote stage and update runVoteAnimation to animate paths down each tree, matching the prediction animation.

The vote animation currently counts votes upward with a 380 ms interval. To match the prediction effect, each tree’s path should walk down and reveal its vote once the branch finishes moving. The reveal counter must advance only after the path animation completes for that specific tree.

The vote animation should mirror the prediction effect exactly: each tree walks its branch down, then reveals its vote, and merging begins once every tree is done. The stage must be switched to "vote" before starting so the path highlighting actually renders.

Rather than forcing the stage to "vote", a dedicated animation flag such as `voteAnimating` will control when path highlighting appears. This lets the vote animation run regardless of which stage the user is currently on.

The vote animation now mirrors the prediction effect exactly. It advances `pathIndex` one step per tick until each tree reaches its leaf, then reveals that tree’s vote. The stage switches to "vote", the focus tree resets to zero, and the flow direction stays forward throughout.

The vote animation now advances to the next tree after each branch finishes, resetting the path index and switching focus. Once all trees are done, it triggers merging and stops the timer. TreeView will show branch paths during the vote stage as well. The fullscreen overlay currently only has a Close button, so the full toolbar still needs to be added.

The toolbar will be extracted into a reusable component so the same set of buttons can appear inside the fullscreen overlay. The redundant growth effect will be fixed by removing focusTree from its dependencies entirely.
